description: Land Title Settlement Department - Adagala, Aluthwewa, Thalawa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110101 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances) in various villages and divisions. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
